subject: Academic incubator — pricing override & convertibility of promo credits
messages:
From: Dr. Emma Park <emma.park@neurolabs.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@neurolabs.ai
Date: 2029-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: academic incubator pricing path

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for reaching out and for the quick intro. A couple of clarifying Qs before I loop in our program director:

- The incubator is hosted through our university affiliated non-profit arm — will Redwood be able to issue invoices to our non-profit tax entity (EIN attached)?
- Typical monthly token consumption estimate across the 30 teams? We expect bursty usage during demo weeks, lower steady usage otherwise.
- On convertibility: are you proposing promotional credits that are fully convertible to a discounted reserved commitment, or only a partial conversion? Our grants require clear audit trails.

I attached the EIN and a short budget summary. If you can share a short pricing summary with stacking rules (academic + promo) that would help.

Best,
Emma
Dr. Emma Park
Executive Director, NeuroLabs Research Incubator

Attachments: EIN_letter.pdf, budget_summary.xlsx
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Emma Park <emma.park@neurolabs.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-08-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: academic incubator pricing path

Emma — thanks for the fast reply and for the docs. High level answers below and happy to jump on a call this week to walk the program through the ops side.

- Invoicing: we can invoice to your non-profit entity; legal will need the EIN and a short W-9-equivalent for our finance team.
- Consumption: rough estimate from your note: 30 teams, ~6 devs each, expected monthly tokens 7M–18M with 2x spikes during demo weeks. If you have a more granular weekly profile that helps our capacity planning.
- Convertibility: our standard promo credits expire and are not convertible to reserved capacity by default. That said, we can propose a one-time convertibility carveout (subject to RevOps/legal) that allows up to $15k of promo credits to convert to a 6-month reserved commitment at a 20% discount.

Attached: short program one-pager and a draft SOW outline to help the legal/regulatory review.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll route a provisional pricing option to Ben for structuring (cc’d).
2) If OK, we’ll draft a conditional addendum that ties convertibility to a signed MOU and usage cap (to satisfy grant audit).
3) Finance/legal exchange templates and invoice path.

Do you have availability Thurs 9–11 PT?

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: program_onepager.pdf, Research_Incubator_SOW.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Dr. Emma Park <emma.park@neurolabs.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-08-15T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: academic incubator pricing path — pricing options

Emma / Sofia — looping in pricing. Quick, pragmatic options we can offer today (provisional, requires RevOps sign-off):

Option A (Program-Friendly):
- $50k one-time promotional credits distributed over 12 months to the incubator pool.
- Academic institution discount: 20% off hosted unit rate, stackable with promo credits.
- Convertibility carveout: up to $15k of the promo credits may be converted to a 6-month reserved capacity commit at a 20% discounted rate. Conversion must be requested within 9 months of grant activation.
- Usage cap and reporting: monthly usage cap agreed in MOU; finance will receive monthly token usage CSV for audit.

Option B (Conservative):
- $30k promotional credits, no convertibility. 25% academic discount applied to overages.

Notes and constraints:
- Legal needs the non-profit invoicing docs and a short MOU referencing grant restrictions.
- Convertibility requires a short approval by Revenue Ops and a minimum 6-month commit on reserved. We can waive the typical 12-month minimum under a conditional escalation if legal and finance sign off.

I attached a compact pricing_options.pdf with the math and candidate SKUs for reserved capacity. If you'd like, we can model a demo-week burst buffer (short-term burst credits) to keep demo latency predictable.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_options.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-08-16T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NeuroLabs incubator — request for pricing override and commit-waiver

Team — forwarding the exchange. Summary and ask:

Summary: NeuroLabs is an academic incubator tied to a university non-profit; they run 30 teams with predictable bursts. Their grant terms make committing to a 12-month reserved contract difficult. They have strong program PR value and could become a channel partner for other university incubators.

Requested exception:
- Approve Option A but waive the 12-month reserved minimum; allow conversion of up to $15k of promo credits to a 6-month reserved commit.
- Approve 20% academic discount stackable with promo credits.
- Allow expiry extension for the promo credits to 12 months (instead of standard 6 months).

Attachments: pilot_scope.xlsx (usage profile), budget_summary.xlsx (grant structure)

Rationale:
- High upstream channel potential for similar academic programs.
- Low immediate revenue risk since we limit conversion to $15k and require MOU with usage caps.
- Competitive: other providers offer academic stacking for incubators, we risk losing the PR/partnership if we can’t be flexible.

Request: expedited approval for a provisional exception so we can share an MOU with NeuroLabs before their next board meeting on Aug 22.

Thanks — Sofia
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-08-17T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: NeuroLabs incubator — request for pricing override and commit-waiver

Sofia / Ben — I’m OK with a provisional exception on the terms below, contingent on legal and finance review. Conditions:

1) Limit convertibility to $15k and include a one-way conversion (credits -> reserved) with a signed MOU that explicitly documents grant auditability and invoicing entity.
2) Extend promo expiry to 12 months but require a monthly usage cap and automated alerts at 60/80/95% thresholds.
3) Revenue Ops will approve the deal once Legal confirms the MOU language.

I created HubSpot deal D-78321 and linked the draft MOU: https://hubspot.redwood.example/deal/78321. Ben — please drop the pricing SKU and the reserved SKU we’ll use in the deal record.

Ben/Sofia — once legal signs, marketing should draft a joint case study placeholder to protect PR upside.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships Operations, Redwood Inference
